summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on which specific data points should be imported or calculated for ad performance analysis. [p1] advised against importing raw metrics like VAC (visual adjusted contacts) and ROTS, noting that these are calculable figures. They also questioned the necessity of 'grp' data.

[p1] provided definitions for GRP (Gross Rating Points), clarifying it represents the total number of impressions delivered by an ad schedule as a percentage of the market population (adults 18+).

Ultimately, [me] confirmed that the necessary metrics will be handled internally by their team.
decisions: The raw data for VAC and ROTS should not be imported.
